data.title: bn-36x3b: recursive CML defs with measure-based termination under pre-charged budgets

data.body: [risk:high][NO FINDINGS] Whole-range assessment for c997f17784891e040053422c89124145c23b05ad..9517a72d1f7915783d45c2fd41889a508ead76da. Failure modes: unsound termination, planner-builder divergence, binder capture, recursion leakage, or resource exhaustion. The guards at elab.rs:1130-1364 and fail-closed lowering at lower.rs:633-642 address them. Edge cases: zero, negative, and i64-edge measures; varied decrements; unreachable branches; nested calls; fan-out; and captured binders. Tests cover these at tests/recursion.rs:50-210 and tests/resource_bounds.rs:719-917. Rollback: revert both range commits together. This restores typed refusal of recursive defs without artifact migration. Monitoring: track typed recursion and limit errors, Usage growth, panics, stack faults, and memory faults. This change adds no external telemetry. Validation: I reviewed all 13 changed files and traced call, proof, plan, build, normalization, and lowering paths. I did not execute tests under this metadata-only contract. The risk:critical human-approval gate remains separate. This LGTM cannot authorize release, deployment, or qualification.
